Examples and galleries

Source: vignettes/examples.Rmd
examples.Rmd

All examples of rvis in one place: the examples of every chart type, drawn by every plotter, in the chart guides; and the example dashboards that come with the package.

Chart examples

Each chart guide shows its chart types on one R data set, with an example for each plotter drawing that type. The examples need the plotting package of their plotter; with the package installed, you can copy and run them as they are.

The chart type and plotter reference lists the wrapper functions of each chart type with their arguments, and the configuration reference the settings of each plotter. Interactive charts shows how clicks on charts become shiny inputs.

Example dashboards

rvis comes with 40 example dashboards (YAML files in folder dashboards of the package). List them with rvisDashboardExample(), and run one with runDashboard(rvisDashboardExample("<name>")):

rvisDashboardExample()                              # name, group, title and file of each example
runDashboard(rvisDashboardExample("faithful"))      # runs one
file.edit(rvisDashboardExample("faithful"))         # opens its configuration, to copy and change it

They are in three groups:

  • Gallery: 20 apps of the Shiny gallery rebuilt from YAML, with a screenshot of each.
  • Showcase: two large dashboards combining most features.
  • Basics: small dashboards showing one feature each, explained in the dashboard guides.
